verdict.rationale: Autumn is a billing and entitlements layer, so hosted invoicing is a fair question to ask of it. However, the evidence never documents sending hosted invoices, an online invoice payment page, or automatic payment reminders or dunning. The customer billing portal for managing subscriptions and end-of-period usage billing are adjacent features, not invoice delivery with reminders.

support.subject: As a finance-ops user, I can send hosted invoices with online payment and automatic reminders
